metrics.result:
The pie chart video is rendered: `./out/film.mp4`. It's 7 s, 1920×1080, and the script is at `./film.reel`.

I checked a strip of frames from the finished file. The pie draws on and shows Rent 40%, Salaries 35%, Marketing 15% and Other 10%, with a legend and the title "Where our budget goes". The last frame in the strip is blank, which fits the planned blur-out at the end. I didn't pull a frame from inside the exit itself.

The script lints clean, with no errors or warnings.

There's also a `./out/strip.png` contact strip and a `./out/frame.png` test still in the folder.

checklist.item: pie or donut chart with four slices
checklist.evidence: Pie with green, mint, yellow, coral slices.
Legend lists Rent, Salaries, Marketing, Other, but it is tiny.
Legend shows 40%, 35%, 15%, 10%, and slice sizes match.
Slices sweep and grow from 0.29s to 1.46s.

problems: The legend text is tiny for a 1080p video and hard to read. The percentages are not on the slices.
The composition is unbalanced. The pie sits left of centre and the legend is small and crowded next to it. The right half of the frame is empty.
The title is small and the hierarchy is weak. Most of the frame is unused.
The pulses are barely visible, so the middle of the video is static from about 2s to 5.5s. The last ~1s is an empty gradient.
The legend sits close to the pie with no clear link between swatch and slice. The Rent and Salaries greens are similar.
judge.verdict: The video is correct and readable, but the layout is generic and unbalanced. The legend is tiny, the right side of the frame is empty, and the end is a blank frame. The user would probably ask for bigger labels and a centred layout.
